title: Portfolio Metric
description: Single measurable claim used on the site. Every metric must carry a source note; values stay null until actually measured.

label.description: Human-readable metric name, e.g. 'Avg. vehicle waiting time (PPO)'.

value.description: Measured value. Use null while unmeasured. Numbers must not be estimates; strings allowed for non-numeric facts (e.g. 'Socket.IO').

unit.description: Unit of measure, e.g. 's/veh', 'vehicles/hour', 'count', 'runs'. Use '—' or '' when unitless.

note.description: Context needed to interpret the value: scenario, baseline comparison, date range, caveats. Empty string allowed.

source.description: Where the number came from: file, run batch, dashboard, export. Required and non-empty for any non-null value; 'TODO' allowed only while value is null.

examples.label: Avg. vehicle waiting time — PPO agent
examples.note: Mean ± std across 30 runs, medium-demand scenario, 300s warmup excluded.
